input: Exact source text captured once by the bounded source reader, including BOM and original CRLF bytes; ordered prepared source snapshot is the existing semantic input.
transformation: Existing import-line removal, CRLF-to-LF joining and JavaScript trim semantics are unchanged.
invariants: Segments completely cover nonempty prepared bytes in order without overlaps or gaps.
Each interval copies the same byte sequence; removed imports, CR and trimmed whitespace remain gaps in original-source coordinates.
Empty/import-only files have null preparedIndex and no segments.
Nonempty preparedIndex values exactly enumerate the observed source snapshot; empty files do not renumber later modules incorrectly.
Source text, prepared text, map, pass execution and source subject have distinct exact artifact identities.
producer: readCheckedSourceSnapshot records provenance in the same pass that prepares actual compiler inputs; no source file rereads.
consumers: future portable declaration/node origins and map composition
replay: Recompute preparation and segments from archived UTF-8 source bytes, compare every prepared source in order, require exact source-subject identity and bounded resolution. The selected build archive/graph must authenticate the observed provenance; successful projection alone cannot authenticate a file path.
compatibility: Historical graphs lacking this debug product remain readable. This is the preparation edge only, not a complete OriginGraph or an emitted JS/declaration map.
remaining: Parser/elaborator event side table bound to prepared source indices and exact byte spans
Core-to-runtime/specialization/target origin policies and stable node relations
Generated JS and declaration UTF-16 positions plus ECMA-426 emission
